people.name: Beth-arabah
people.line: Town and wilderness area in Judah, also associated with Benjamin.

people.name: Beth-hoglah
people.line: Town on the border between Judah and Benjamin.

people.name: Bohan
people.line: Reubenite after whom a boundary stone was named

people.name: Reuben
people.line: Firstborn son of Jacob and Leah

translations.web: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
translations.bsb: went up to Beth-hoglah, proceeded north of Beth-arabah, and went up to the Stone of Bohan son of Reuben.
translations.kjv: And the border went up to Bethhogla, and passed along by the north of Betharabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben:
